title: btn
description: Portable, HAL-agnostic button debounce library in C. Supports short click, double click, long press and hold-repeat events. Includes a ready-to-use STM32 HAL port. Zero dynamic allocation.

title: dc-motor-controller
description: Portable DC motor controller library in C. Supports both open-loop and closed-loop (PID) control. HAL-agnostic design — runs on STM32, ESP32 or any platform with a PWM driver.

title: agenda-medica
description: Technical challenge: full-stack medical scheduling web app built with Flask, SQLite and Docker. REST API with appointment management, patient records and a clean web interface.

title: webxr-demos
description: Interactive WebXR demos with A-Frame: 3D primitive morphing, an atomic model simulation and a drag-and-drop 3D model viewer with AR mode via AR.js. Built as an academic Computer Graphics project.
